purpose: Deduplicate repair evidence without removing public outcomes, diagnostics or provenance.

inline_reference_rules.artifact_revision_ids: Resolve every ID against failure.artifact_revisions, preserving the listed order. Local checks with unpublished outputs retain their original artifact_revisions map and task_id/attempt_id, bound by failure.task_attempt_ids; these revisions are not asserted to be exported.
inline_reference_rules.check_defaults_ref: Merge the named failure.repair_projection.check_defaults object into the check, including its evidence defaults. Original and default fields may not overlap; all values remain inline.
inline_reference_rules.inherited_fields: An evidence.inherited_fields entry has exactly the same value as the enclosing check field.
inline_reference_rules.stdout_omitted: Only recognized normal successful editable-install progress is omitted. Its hash and byte count bind immutable original evidence; all failure stdout, stderr and unrecognized output remain inline. The model does not need to retrieve omitted progress.
inline_reference_rules.interfaces_from_units: For a leaf marked interfaces_from_units, reconstruct interfaces in leaf.unit_ids order as {unit_id:id,title,interface} from state.units. Unavailable unit records leave original interfaces inline.

no_remote_file_access: All decision facts and reference targets are inline; report paths only identify immutable evidence.
measurement_boundary: UTF-8 serialized request bytes from prepareDecision; byte reduction is not model token reduction or provider acceptance.
